evals.name: live-catalog-over-static-hints
evals.prompt: I need to analyze an existing Lynx performance trace. In this simulated environment, agent-lynx is on PATH and its live catalog only lists lynx-performance-review for analyzing existing traces and lynx-trace-record for collecting new ones. Give the exact commands to discover and load the appropriate Skill, plus the handoff for analyzing this recorded trace. Answer from the simulated catalog.
evals.expected_output: Lists the live catalog, loads lynx-performance-review, and hands the existing trace to its instructions.
expectations: Uses agent-lynx skills list as the first Skill discovery step.
Uses agent-lynx skills get lynx-performance-review based on the description returned in the live catalog.
Hands the recorded trace to the selected Skill's analysis instructions.

evals.name: temporary-public-cli-invocation
evals.prompt: I want to discover the Lynx capability for inspecting console logs. agent-lynx is absent from PATH and the environment has npm. The simulated catalog returns lynx-devtool for console logs. Give me only the commands to discover and load the Skill in this situation. I need a temporary invocation that leaves the project and global installations as they are.
evals.expected_output: Gives the temporary public npm commands to list Skills and load lynx-devtool.
expectations: Uses npx --yes agent-lynx@latest skills list to discover the available capabilities.
Uses npx --yes agent-lynx@latest skills get lynx-devtool to load the matching Skill.
Keeps both commands on the same temporary public CLI path and leaves project and global installations alone.

evals.name: public-repository-fallback
evals.prompt: I need to check CSS property support for a Lynx version. The simulated agent-lynx catalog has DevTool and Recorder entries and no CSS compatibility Skill. The public Lynx Skills release contains skills/lynx-check-css-support/SKILL.md and its bundled resources. Name the files to read next and state what you would tell me if neither discovery source is readable. Use the simulated results in your answer.
evals.expected_output: Loads the CSS compatibility Skill directly from the public repository and describes how to report failed discovery.
expectations: Uses the catalog result to decide that the matching Skill must be discovered outside the CLI.
Reads skills/lynx-check-css-support/SKILL.md and its required bundled resources from lynx-community/skills.
Uses the repository path for the repository-only Skill throughout the answer.
Reports which discovery sources could not be read if both lookups fail and leaves the compatibility result undetermined.

evals.name: reuse-loaded-recorder-fixture-skill
evals.prompt: I only need to update a mock response in an existing Lynx Recorder fixture. The current catalog lists lynx-recorder, lynx-recorder-fixture, and lynx-devtool. The lynx-recorder-fixture instructions were already loaded for this fixture earlier in this session and the catalog has stayed the same. Tell me how you would continue the edit.
evals.expected_output: Reuses the already loaded fixture editing instructions and keeps the work focused on the existing fixture.
expectations: Chooses lynx-recorder-fixture for changing mock data in the supplied fixture.
Reuses the already loaded instructions for that unchanged Skill.
Uses the specialist instructions for editing and checking the existing fixture.
